Dheeraj Singh @ Dheeraj Kumar Singh, aged about 24 years, son of Balmukund Singh, P.O. Ganiari
Kala, P.S. Dhurki, District Garhwa (Jharkhand) ... ... Petitioner
-Versus -
The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party

------
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Sanjay Kumar Pandey, Advocate For the State : M/s. Amrita Kumari, A.P.P.
-----
02/07.02.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Dhurki P.S. Case No. 47 of 2022, for the offences registered under Sections 302, 201/34 of the I.P.C. and subsequently added Section 376(D)(A) of the I.P.C. and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned A.C.J.M.,
Nagaruntari.
3. The accused persons are alleged to have gang raped the victim.
After raping her, they inserted a piece of wood in her private parts and thereafter, throttled her to death.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that the name of the petitioner has come in the confession of co-accused persons.
5. Mr. Amrita Kumari, learned A.P.P. has submitted that the investigation is still under progress.
